remove_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to remove an appended delayed memory report from the session context.
rules: Emit <REMOVE_DELAYED_MEMORY: id > marker to remove single APPENDED_DELAYED_MEMORY from context in the next turn/message; saved reports are never deleted from storage
id - is a placeholder word; replace it with the 6-character id prefix shown in <DELAYED_MEMORY>.
